answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use unpredictable synchronized roll-calls. At random moments each epoch, every agent must answer a fresh liveness challenge within a narrow window, a violet signal each genuine agent must echo back before it fades. A single operator cannot keep thousands of fake identities responsive at once: each identity stands on its own ledge of bandwidth and compute, and the roll-call demands all of them together. Missed roll-calls decay that identity's influence, while honest agents minding one seat answer routinely and keep full standing.
